name: Deckhand
blurb: Twenty seasons before the mast on other men's schooners. Now the deck is yours.

perks.name: Quick hands
perks.text: Sail changes take a quarter less time.

perks.name: Sail trimmer
perks.text: A wider sweet spot when trimming by hand, and 5% more speed when the sheets are right.

name: Fisherman
blurb: You know every reef from Sand Island to Outer, and what whitefish fetch in every port.

perks.name: Fish market
perks.text: Always knows this week's fish prices in every port. The Apostles reefs come pre-charted later.

perks.name: Weather eye
perks.text: Reads the barometer and the sky well: the chart's forecasts are a third tighter.

name: Lumberjack / Teamster
blurb: Logs down the Sioux River and the mill's lumber to the dock. You can carry more than most.

perks.name: Strong back
perks.text: Carries crates faster on foot, and one more CU in the rowboat.

perks.name: Builder
perks.text: Building materials cost 15% less and go up faster.

name: Saloon Keeper
blurb: You poured for every dockhand on Minnesota Point and heard everything they said.

perks.name: Saloon talk
perks.text: Better rumors in every saloon. Bribes cost a quarter less once there are officers to bribe.

perks.name: Whiskey trick
perks.text: The whiskey trick works faster, and on bigger crews.

name: Ex-Navy
blurb: Gunner's mate on the Michigan until the Navy had no more use for you.

perks.name: Gunnery
perks.text: Better aim with the cannon and the swivel, and a faster swivel reload.

name: Poacher / Trapper
blurb: Winters on the traplines of the mainland, and a pair of furs nobody asked you about.

perks.name: Woodcraft
perks.text: Tracking, better trap yields, faster carcass carrying and slower warmth loss.

perks.name: Boot lockpick
perks.text: A lockpick hidden in your boot, and quieter on foot.
